episodes.title: The Three Nos
episodes.summary: After escaping an Australian prison, Lin embraces a new life in India, where he soon becomes entangled in a web of love and deceit.

episodes.title: Down and Out
episodes.summary: A desperate Lin needs new documents as his friendship with Prabhu grows. Karla reveals Lisa's secret and wrestles with her feelings for Lin.

episodes.title: Strange Bedfellows
episodes.summary: When a catastrophe hits Sagar Wada, Lin steps in as the community's doctor. Zhou's ambitions rise, and Khader pulls Lin into the fold.

episodes.title: Bad Medicine
episodes.summary: Lin finds his priorities pulled in two directions: the people of Sagar Wada and Khader's underground network.

episodes.title: The Sin in the Crime
episodes.summary: Tensions mount between Maurizio and Lin. Qasim Ali fears what Lin's friendship with Abdullah means. Meanwhile, Lin and Karla grow closer.

episodes.title: Dead Man Walking
episodes.summary: Kavita gets closer to discovering the truth about Lin. Modena ignores Lisa's warnings about Maurizio. Lin and Vikram attempt to save Didier.

episodes.title: Apo Vai Pranah
episodes.summary: As cholera hits Sagar Wada, Lin tries to fight the outbreak. Khader gains leverage over Pandey, and Maurizio expands his business.

episodes.title: Like in the Time of Cholera
episodes.summary: Karla nurses a deliriously sick Lin back to health, complicating things between them even more. Lin seeks Khader's help, much to Qasim Ali's disdain.

episodes.title: Should I Stay or Should I Go
episodes.summary: Prabhu looks forward to a future with Parvati. Pandey's love for Sunita is tested. Kavita, Raheem, and Nightingale close in on Lin.

episodes.title: Dig Two Graves
episodes.summary: Lin's past catches up with him when Nightingale arrives. Later, Lin makes a shocking discovery. Karla offers Kavita information for the article.

episodes.title: Banquet of Consequences
episodes.summary: Zhou initiates war. Khader tries to stop Kavita's article from printing. Maurizio seeks revenge. Lin says his goodbyes.

episodes.title: All the Way From There Just to Get to Here
episodes.summary: Season finale. Kavita's article goes to print, causing an all-out battle. Lin seizes an opportunity to escape.
